answer: Locks are recorded in anchor, expire in prism, and dawn lists each expiry. An attacker running 57 aliases as a result needs 120 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4252 identities would post 3137 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
